description: Source code for Ethernet bridge shell commands in Zephyr OS, including functions for managing network interfaces within Ethernet bridges, such as adding/removing interfaces, enabling/disabling transmission, and displaying bridge info.

methods.name: get_idx
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer index, with validation.

methods.name: cmd_bridge_addif
methods.description: Adds a network interface to a bridge.

methods.name: cmd_bridge_delif
methods.description: Removes a network interface from a bridge.

methods.name: cmd_bridge_allow_tx
methods.description: Enables or disables transmission on a bridged interface.

methods.name: bridge_show
methods.description: Displays information about a specific Ethernet bridge.

methods.name: cmd_bridge_show
methods.description: Displays information about bridges, either specific or all.
